name: Apples and Art Orchards
tagline: Apple Picking i Julian CA All Natural Apples
description: Apples and Art Orchards is a family-run farm in Julian, CA. It grows Apples and Pears, with seasonal availability through autumn and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
